themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents capable of performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including their development, capabilities, and risks.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, review, and debug code, including their impact and security implications.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles about AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as research papers, earnings calls, or user feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Articles exploring the impact of AI on job markets, hiring processes, employee fears, and the skills needed for future careers.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles examining the use of AI-generated users for research and testing, including their effectiveness and ethical considerations.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles covering AI's application in the early stages of design and research, from generating ideas to analyzing qualitative data.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles that highlight or compare various AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in their work.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Articles focused on how AI is being used to conduct or improve usability testing processes and analyze results.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Articles discussing how AI is used to analyze and understand user sentiment from various sources like social media and reviews.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Articles exploring AI's role in conducting and analyzing qualitative research, including interviews and thematic analysis.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
